usage.callShape: POST https://property.payapi.market/stamp-duty with JSON body {price, is_first_time_buyer?, is_additional_property?, is_non_resident?}
usage.outputShape: body.total_tax (number, GBP), body.effective_rate (%), body.buyer_type (string), body.breakdown[] (each {band, rate, tax}), body.price (echo)
usage.guide: Calculate UK Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT). POST a JSON body with required field price (property purchase price in GBP, e.g. 350000). Optional booleans: is_first_time_buyer (discount up to £625k), is_additional_property (5% surcharge), is_non_resident (extra 2% surcharge) — all default false. Pay $0.001 USDC via x402 on Base. The 200 response is synchronous: read body.total_tax for the SDLT owed, body.effective_rate for the rate, and body.breakdown[] for the per-band table.
